author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have discovered that certain bacteria can stabilize toxic uranium in contaminated water by transforming it into a rare, stable pentavalent compound. This breakthrough offers a promising, sustainable method for bioremediation of uranium pollution in mining areas.  

Source Article: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-026-72560-z
